description: Vorasidenib can be used as an option to treat grade 2 oligodendroglioma in people 12 years and over when the cancer has a susceptible isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH) 1 or IDH2 mutation, and the person has had surgery and does not immediately need chemotherapy or radiotherapy.

extensions.name: statement description
extensions.value: The U.K. National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) has recommended vorasidenib as an option to treat grade 2 oligodendroglioma in people 12 years and over whose cancer has a susceptible IDH1 or IDH2 mutation, following surgery, when they do not immediately need chemotherapy or radiotherapy. Vorasidenib is recommended within its marketing authorisation and subject to the commercial arrangement available to the NHS.
